You'll partner closely with revenue leadership and the finance lead on quote-to-cash improvements and billing operations, and you'll build the processes and infrastructure that let the accounting function scale without breaking. You: Have 8+ years of accounting experience at a high-growth technology company, with a track record of taking on increasing ownership of the function. You have deep expertise in US GAAP, technical accounting, and SaaS revenue recognition, and you're comfortable with multi-entity and international operations, transfer pricing, and inter-company accounting. You understand billing systems and revenue operations well enough to partner directly with commercial teams, not just report on them after the fact. You're a builder who wants to design the systems, not just operate them, and you stay close to the details even as you take on more scope. Bonus if you've led an ERP migration or can write SQL to answer your own questions instead of waiting on someone else's dashboard.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance
jobs.description_text: Job: You will help shape Parallel’s business and financial strategy as a member of the Strategic Finance team. You’ll partner with leaders across the company, own key financial models, and use your analysis to drive critical company decisions. Projects may span compute analysis, pricing and packaging, unit economics by product, strategic distribution partnerships, and setting up KPIs for the business. You’ll pull data from wherever it lives and set it up for ongoing reporting to the leadership team. Your scope will grow as fast as you earn it. You: You’ve spent a few years in a high-rigor seat like investment banking or strategy consulting, followed by an investing role at a private equity or growth firm, or a finance role at a high-growth company. You’ve built detailed, complex models from first principles, and you can defend every assumption when someone pushes back. You’ve used AI tools to do real work faster, and you’re eager to find new ways to apply them. You take ownership without being asked, flag problems early, and want to grow into a finance and general business leader at Parallel.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description_text: Job: We’re hiring a senior brand designer who’s a generalist first, with a particular strength in technical storytelling and information design. You’ll help explain a deeply technical product to a wider audience, and apply and extend our brand system across the work we put into the world. You’ll be part of the design team, working closely with technical marketing and DevRel to shape the story from the first outline. The work includes diagrams, benchmark and eval visualizations, docs and API illustrations, and visual essays like The Web as Ground Truth https://parallel.ai/the-web-as-ground-truth. You’ll also work across launch pages, blog art direction, conference and keynote graphics, motion, and social. You: Your portfolio shows strong typography, composition, and range across brand, web, and motion. You can learn a complex subject, find the idea that matters, and explain it at different levels of depth. You bring ideas to the narrative and are comfortable working through them in prototypes and motion. Experience with developer or technical products is a plus, as is a strong writing instinct. You can handle a high volume of work, make good decisions quickly, and follow through on the production details. About Parallel Design: We design for a web used by both people and agents, grounding our work in real code, data, and evidence. jobs.title: Marketing Ops
jobs.description_text: Job: You will own Parallel's marketing systems and the data that runs through them. You'll own the HubSpot and Salesforce integration. Together with Revenue Operations, you'll move us to an account- and contact-based model that sales and marketing both trust. You'll build lead scoring and the attribution model that shows which demand generation actually creates pipeline. With data engineering, you'll rebuild how product data flows from BigQuery into our marketing systems, so the whole team acts on usage signals as well as form fills. You'll run the stack end to end, from enrichment and events to reporting, and build agentic workflows where they beat a manual process. You: You’re a problem-solver and inherently fired up by challenges. You’re curious about new technology and approach it from an experimental mentality. You have bias to action and know how to balance short term progress with longer term systems-building. You've owned the marketing technology stack at a B2B or developer-first company: marketing automation, BI, enrichment, events and the ETL behind them.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description_text: Job: You will build and lead Parallel's accounting function as we scale a generational AI infrastructure company. As our first Controller, you'll own accounting end to end: month-end close, financial statements, US GAAP and revenue recognition, international accounting decisions, audit readiness, tax and statutory compliance, and internal controls. Most importantly, you'll build the accounting team that runs it. You'll set the close process, chart of accounts, and core policies. You'll drive technical positions on usage-based revenue, compute commitments, and cost treatment, and choose the core systems that accounting, finance, and revenue operations will run on. You'll partner with finance, revenue operations, legal, and other functions as they mature. The business is scaling quickly, so you'll balance building for today with an eye toward the company we're becoming. You: Have stood up an accounting function before and have a track record of strong hires to show for it. You bring 8–10+ years of progressive accounting experience in high-growth tech, a CPA, a Big 4 background, and an AI-first approach to problem solving. You know US GAAP cold, especially usage-based revenue models. You'll get into the details when it matters, but your focus will be on building the team, systems, and processes that do the work at scale. You know which controls matter now and which would slow the business down and balance the tradeoffs. You've selected and implemented accounting systems, automat

jobs.title: Procurement Lead
jobs.description_text: Job: Be a frugal, strategic, and and hard negotiator for Parallel. You will build and lead Parallel's Procurement function as we scale a generational AI infrastructure company. You’ll lead our compute negotiations, one of largest cost centers, structuring commitments with cloud and infrastructure providers that keep pace with fast, hard-to-forecast growth. You’ll own vendor procurement across software, services, and infrastructure, from intake to signature. You’ll also own content and data partnership payouts while are key to enhancing our product performance. You’ll partner closely with finance, accounting, legal, and engineering, and you’ll help hire the team as the function grows. You: You’ve been the first procurement lead at a high-growth tech company and built the function from nothing. You’ve personally negotiated large, complex deals across cloud, AI, data, and software, and you can point to what you won. You understand compute economics: reserved versus on-demand, commit sizing, and the levers that keep things flexible. You’ve owned the full flow from request to contract to payment, so accounting stays clean. You use AI tools to move faster with a lean team. Teams come to you early because you make forecasting, and buying easier, not harder.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Manager, GTM Strategic Finance
jobs.description_text: Job: You will build Parallel’s deal desk and be a core member of the Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategic Finance team. You'll build up this function from the ground up and own how we price, structure, and close deals including many complex strategic enterprise and distribution deals (think clouds, neo-clouds, labs, neo-labs, hyper-scalers and others). Every non-standard "deal" runs through you. You’ll stand up approval matrices, quoting workflows, and a clear path for non-standard terms that keep pace with the high-growth AI Native and Enterprise teams. You’ll work live deals with sales leadership, account executives and decide when to hold firm and when to bend, inside the pricing and margin guardrails set with GTM Strategic Finance. You’ll partner with legal on contract terms and with accounting so every deal books cleanly and bills correctly. You’re accountable for deal velocity, terms discipline, and making sure what we sign is something we can deliver. You: You’ve run a deal desk at a high growth software or infrastructure company with consumption or committed-spend pricing. You’ve structured strategic deals, ramp deals, prepaid commitments, and multi-year contracts, and you know where the risk sits in each. You understand how deal terms affect revenue recognition, billing, and margin. You’ve used AI tools to do real work faster, and you’re eager to find new ways to apply them. You take ownership without being asked, flag problems early, and want to grow into a GTM finance lead

jobs.title: GTM Strategic Finance
jobs.description_text: Job: You will be a core part of the Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategic Finance team. You’ll partner directly with revenue leadership on hiring plans, quota and capacity models, compensation plans, and spend. Additionally, you will help inform complex strategic distribution and customer deals. You’ll turn pipeline, attainment, and unit economics into recommendations that impact the sales organization. You’ll build the operating plan and bookings forecast for the sales org and hold it accountable to them. You’ll bring a financial lens to pricing and packaging across usage-based and committed-spend models, and you’ll set the credits and discount policy, as well as margin targets that the deal desk enforces. You’ll work with the broader Corporate Finance team on sales planning and board reporting. As the function grows, you’ll be instrumental, early, contributor and grow with Parallel. You: You’ve spent a few years in a high-rigor seat like investment banking or strategy consulting, followed by an investing role at a private equity or growth firm, or a GTM finance role at a high-growth company. You’ve set sales strategy including quotas, building capacity models, and commission plans alongside sales leaders who trusted your numbers. You’ve used AI tools to do real work faster, and you’re eager to find new ways to apply them. You take ownership without being asked, flag problems early, and want to grow into a finance and general business leader at Parallel.

jobs.title: R&D Strategic Finance Lead

These are some of the highest-stakes decisions we make, and they call for structured planning over medium- and long-term horizons. You’ll track training, inference and infrastructure spend against commitments and product usage, and forecast where it’s headed as the product scales rapidly. You’ll partner directly with company leaders on headcount plans, budgets, and the tradeoffs between building, buying and adding compute. You’ll work with Parallel’s procurement lead on compute and vendor negotiations, and with Accounting on how R&D costs are treated and capitalized. You’ll turn cost per query, contribution and gross margin, and infrastructure efficiency into a clear strategy for the company. You: You’ve owned Finance for an engineering or infrastructure organization at a high-growth tech company, ideally one where compute or cloud was a major cost line. You understand reserved vs. on-demand pricing, GPU commitments, and how utilization drives long-term unit economics. You can sit with engineering leaders, understand what they’re building, and turn it into a cost model they trust. jobs.title: ABM
jobs.description_text: Job: You will build Parallel’s account-based marketing program from the ground up. You’ll design and run 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many campaigns against our highest-value enterprise accounts, working directly with the enterprise sales team to pick targets, map buying committees, and personalize outreach that moves deals forward. You’ll own the campaigns end to end: messaging, channel mix across digital, email, direct mail, events, and executive engagement, and the measurement that proves what worked. You’ll partner with our senior enterprise marketer as a hands-on individual contributor, turning one-off plays into repeatable programs. You’re accountable for account engagement, funnel conversion, and marketing-sourced pipeline. You: Have run ABM and enterprise demand gen at a high-growth B2B technology company, ideally in AI, developer infrastructure, or cloud. You’ve worked inside CRM, marketing automation, intent data, and account intelligence tools, and you use them to segment, target, and measure rather than to report activity. You think in numbers: you know which accounts are warming, which campaigns earned their spend, and why. Your bar for content is high. You write for the channel and the format, you protect the brand’s voice, and nothing you ship reads like AI slop. You use AI-native tools fluently but don’t lean on them for ideas. You’d rather build the program yourself than manage someone else doing it.

jobs.title: Marketing Recruiter
jobs.description_text: Job: You will own full-cycle recruiting for Parallel’s marketing team, running searches from intake through close across product marketing, demand gen, growth, content, brand, and marketing ops. You’ll partner directly with marketing leadership and the founders to define role scope, build interview loops, and calibrate what “great” looks like for each role, including how to evaluate portfolios, work samples, and take-home exercises. You’ll drive sourcing and outbound for hard-to-fill and senior roles, manage candidates through the pipeline without letting anyone go cold, and help sharpen the scorecards and playbooks the team runs on as headcount scales fast. You’ll report on pipeline health and hiring velocity to the recruiting lead, and you’ll be trusted to close high-conviction offers on your own. You: Have run full-cycle recruiting at an early-stage or fast-growing company, with marketing hiring as a core part of your desk. You know the difference between a product marketer and a demand gen lead, and you can tell a strong portfolio from a polished one. You write outbound that gets responses from people who aren’t looking, and you know how to close a candidate who has three other offers. You work well solo but you’re just as sharp coordinating with other recruiters on shared priorities, and you move fast because slow hiring kills momentum at a company this stage.

jobs.title: Product Marketing, Index
jobs.description_text: Job: You will own positioning and go-to-market for Index, Parallel’s marketplace for the agentic web. Agent builders get grounded access to high-quality content; publishers, data providers, and creators see how agents use their work and earn from what it contributes. You’ll make the case to both sides: to agent builders, from AI-native startups to the largest enterprises, why Index content produces better answers, and to content owners, from news publishers to independent creators, why they should join, what they learn, and how they earn. You’ll lead launches, new content categories, and the move to self-serve, build proof programs with launch partners, and shape the public narrative on how the open web stays sustainable when agents become its largest users, alongside the founding team. You: Have owned positioning for a product line or company and have marketed a two-sided marketplace or platform. You know how to balance supply and demand, and when one side has to come first. You understand how agents use the web and hold your own with engineers and researchers. You’re comfortable defending a narrative that press, publishers, and the AI community will scrutinize. Media, data licensing, or usage-based monetization experience is a plus. You ask why until the answer is real.

You will own how our team builds, reviews, and ships software with AI, including code review, CI, the merge queue, testing, and deploys. You will build the tools and workflows that remove bottlenecks and help every engineer at Parallel ship faster and with more confidence. About you: Have deep intuition on developer tooling, build systems, CI/CD, and AI assisted development. You see software development changing with AI and want to build the tools this new reality needs. You have strong taste in what makes a tool great to use, and you care about understanding what other engineers need and building tools they love. You might be a good fit if you have: - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience - Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, build systems, or internal platforms that other engineers depend on every day - Hands on experience using AI coding and review agents in your daily workflow, with informed opinions on where they help and where they fall short - A track record of treating engineers as your customers, gathering their input, and driving adoption of tools because they genuinely make work better LIFE AT PARALLEL We believe in a fully in person work culture 5 days a week.

You will drive sourcing and outbound for senior and hard to fill technical roles and keep every candidate moving without anyone going cold. You will help sharpen the scorecards, interviewer training, and playbooks the team runs on as engineering headcount scales quickly, report on pipeline health and pass through rates, and be trusted to close high conviction offers. You: Have run full cycle technical recruiting at an early stage or fast growing company and know how to own engineering searches end to end. You can speak credibly with ML engineers and researchers about their work, and you know the difference between a strong systems engineer and a strong research engineer. You write outbound that gets responses from engineers who are not looking, and you know how to close a candidate weighing offers from the best AI companies in the world. You are fluent in equity and compensation conversations and comfortable navigating visa and immigration timelines. You work well solo but are just as sharp coordinating with other recruiters on shared priorities, and you move fast because momentum matters at a company at this stage.

As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Singapore
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE: We’re hiring the first recruiter on the ground in Singapore to build Notion’s GTM team across Southeast Asia. You’ll own GTM hiring end to end and help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization, recruiting for new and evolving customer-facing roles, including BDRs, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and field sales leadership, that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner closely with the Country Manager, Singapore, sales leadership, and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires. You’ll inherit a global recruiting playbook and develop the operating rhythm for the region. You’ll also have a direct hand in shaping the culture of the SEA team as it forms, and be the subject matter expert on the ground. You’ll use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for, and help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density. jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Proving who someone is online has never been harder or more important. You'll research how to detect fraud and verify identities more accurately. Your work will include detecting AI-generated and manipulated images, understanding how models perform across populations, and finding patterns in how attackers behave. You bring depth in at least one of computer vision, mathematics and statistics, or identity verification and fraud prevention. You test ideas with focused experiments and follow what the results show. You'll work with our ML and engineering teams to turn your findings into defenses for real customers, and you'll get to publish your work. WHAT YOU’LL DO AT PERSONA - Lead research on open problems in identity verification and fraud prevention, using focused experiments to test new ideas quickly. - Develop methods to detect manipulated documents, AI-generated images and emerging fraud attacks. - Evaluate how reliably our models perform across different populations - Uncover the patterns in verification data that reveal fraud, and prove they're real signal and not noise. - Calibrate model confidence and measure fraud events with limited labeled data. - Partner with ML and engineering to turn research prototypes into production models. - Publish at top venues such as CVPR, NeurIPS and USENIX Security, and stay active in the research community. Beyond providing day-to-day support, you’ll work closely with product and engineering teams, acting as a vital bridge between technical and customer-facing functions. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Scaling RL
jobs.description_text: Our team brings deep expertise, genuine ownership, and a drive to push the boundaries of what's scientifically possible. ABOUT THE ROLE We're training frontier models to develop deep scientific knowledge and reasoning for scientific tasks. You’ll study how RL scales with training compute, develop better algorithms, and take ideas from controlled experiments to our largest runs like Periodic Neon https://periodic.com/news/nature-is-our-learning-environment. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design experiments to understand how RL performance scales with compute, model size, data, and reward quality, building on work such as ScaleRL https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13786 - Develop better RL algorithms, spanning policy optimization, advantage estimation, exploration, and credit assignment for long-horizon RL tasks - Build adaptive sampling and curriculum methods that adjust task difficulty, problem selection, and the number of rollouts as models improve - Study bias and stability during RL training, including importance-sampling corrections and methods to tackle policy staleness and training–inference mismatch, as discussed here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GH4JCdAAUYg. - Improve compute efficiency across training and inference through experiments with hyperparameters, such as length penalties, rollout counts, batch sizes, and update schedules. YOU WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE - Hands-on experience training LLMs with reinforcement learning - Strong attention to detail and rigorous approach

jobs.description_text: Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.13332). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning https://pluralis.ai/blog/a-third-path-protocol-learning/. Agora gave us a pretrained 8B model. Post-training is how we make it useful for agentic use-cases. But every post-training stack you've seen assumes a datacenter — synchronous rollouts, fast interconnects, trusted workers. Ours gets none of that. It has to run on consumer GPUs, and Macs spread across the public internet, training a model whose weights no single participant ever holds, with rollouts arriving from a geo-distributed inference pipeline at high latencies. Your primary role is to make RL post-training work here anyway — the algorithms and the system, end-to-end. Our training and inference network is trustless, and the workers are GPUs scattered across the world. Many things can go wrong in this system. Our work spans continuously running pipelines for model weights, configurations, code, and container images. We work closely with research, security, developer infrastructure, and partner engineering teams to turn complex requirements into dependable software. We’re a small, collaborative team with direct ownership of systems that support important partnerships. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a software engineer to build and improve the backend services behind these workflows. You’ll work primarily in Python, take projects from design through production, and make our systems more reliable and easier to operate as partner integrations evolve. The work combines hands-on engineering with careful judgment. You’ll translate requirements about what can be shared into clear, testable business logic, debug problems across system boundaries, and collaborate with the teams that build and use the underlying infrastructure. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. Alongside execution, you will own and improve AIE’s internal operating mechanisms and tooling, and work with leadership to resolve adoption and delivery bottlenecks. This role combines hands-on program ownership with the opportunity to inform AIE priorities and industry strategy, improve how the team operates, and scale successful approaches globally. This role is based in San Francisco, California in the United States. You’ll work closely with software engineering, product, design, and business teams from development through launch and ongoing support. This is a unique opportunity to engage directly with the forefront of AI legal issues. This role reports to our DGC of Hardware. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. We lead OpenAI's commitment to developing and deploying safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), fostering a culture of trust, responsibility, and transparency. Our goal is to continuously learn from deployments, distribute AI’s benefits widely, and ensure that powerful tools remain aligned with human values and safety considerations. Within Safety Systems, the Model Policy team works to ensure that frontier models behave safely and reliably in real-world environments by designing policies that define safe model behavior. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product Velocity
jobs.description_text: About the Team The ChatGPT Velocity team owns the health of the end-to-end developer and deploy loop for ChatGPT-facing services. Our mission is to help ChatGPT engineers ship confidently with a fast, lightweight development cycle and a trusted path to production. ChatGPT development depends on a long chain: local environments, Bazel builds, CI, tests, merges, release candidates, deploys, synthetics, alerts, and production health. When any link is slow, flaky, or unclear, engineers lose hours, fixes reach users later, and on-call load rises. This team turns that cross-cutting drag into owned, measured, and durable improvements. About the Role We are hiring an experienced infrastructure engineer to make ChatGPT development dramatically faster and more reliable. You will work across local development, build systems, CI, deployment infrastructure, test ownership, and production safety signals to reduce the time and attention required to move a healthy change from development to production. This is not a narrow tooling role. The best person for this job will be comfortable diagnosing messy distributed systems, reading developer pain signals from Slack and metrics, building reliable automation, negotiating ownership across teams, and making tradeoffs between velocity and production safety. Strong candidates will bring deep software engineering expertise and an interest in building a technical product in close partnership with its users.
